run_handle_test_results: run handle_test_results to parse test output strings and extract failed, passed counts and time spent
run_extract_first_line_failure: run extract_first_line_failure to parse doctest failure output and return a dict mapping test names to error lines
run_retrieve_artifact: run retrieve_artifact to load JSON artifact files from a directory and return a dict of artifact name to content
build_message_slack_report: build a Message object to compose and post a Slack report summarizing doc test results with failures or success
run_retrieve_available_artifacts: run retrieve_available_artifacts to discover available artifact directories and return a dict of Artifact objects
